integrity: Scientific claims have an analytic combinatorial proof and a standalone finite cross-check. Public-source priority assessments are literature-limited, and independent validation is not represented.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the explicitly defined nonrecurrent, non-reversal-closed binary infinite word W; no claim for recurrent, uniformly recurrent, morphic or reversal-closed sequences. The literal conjecture had already been disproved by a periodic example. New claim concerns an aperiodic counterexample and exact all-n formulas. Unindexed priority overlap remains possible; the finite checker does not prove infinite claims.
title: Exact reflection complexity of the increasing-run binary word
